description: Classification schema for AAO non-precedent NIW (EB-2) decisions. One JSON object per decision.

fields.endeavor_type: one of: entrepreneur_business_plan | employed_professional | researcher_academic | other
fields.outcome: one of exactly these 4 lowercase strings: dismissed | sustained | remanded | withdrawn_moot. sustained = the AAO SUSTAINS THE APPEAL, meaning it reverses/overturns the denial -- the petitioner WINS. dismissed = the AAO DISMISSES THE APPEAL, meaning it upholds/affirms the denial -- the petitioner LOSES. Do not confuse this with a decision merely discussing or 'sustaining' the original officer's reasoning -- what matters is the AAO's own final ruling on the appeal itself.
fields.eb2_classification_met: true if advanced degree / exceptional ability was conceded or found met
fields.dispositive_prong: 1 | 2 | 3 | multiple | none (which Dhanasar prong sank the case; 'none' if sustained)
fields.prongs_reserved: list of prongs the AAO declined to reach (Bagamasbad reservation)
denial_reasons: P1_NATIONAL_IMPORTANCE_NOT_SHOWN        - endeavor impact limited to employer/clients/region
P1_FIELD_VS_ENDEAVOR_CONFLATION         - argued importance of the profession, not the specific endeavor
P1_ECONOMIC_PROJECTIONS_UNSUPPORTED     - job/revenue projections lacked basis or detail
P1_DEPRESSED_AREA_ARGUMENT_REJECTED     - HUBZone/opportunity-zone style argument not credited
P1_SHORTAGE_ARGUMENT_REJECTED           - labor shortage (incl. Schedule A) held not to confer national importance
P2_POSITIONING_INSUFFICIENT             - education/record/progress insufficient to advance endeavor
P2_PAST_ACHIEVEMENTS_NOT_PROBATIVE      - citations/letters/experience didn't show ability to advance THIS endeavor
P2_PLAN_VAGUE_OR_NOT_ACTIONABLE         - no concrete model, funding, customers, or progress
P3_BALANCE_NOT_IN_US_FAVOR              - benefit of waiving labor cert not shown on balance
EVIDENCE_GENERIC_LETTERS                - support letters conclusory/templated, little independent weight
EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT_CORROBORATION     - assertions without relevant, probative, credible evidence (Chawathe)
PROCEDURAL_NEW_EVIDENCE_ON_APPEAL       - late/new evidence not considered or not curative
fields.key_quotes: up to 2 short (<15 word) verbatim fragments that pin the dispositive reasoning
fields.reason_summary: 2-3 plain-English sentences explaining WHY the AAO ruled this way in THIS case -- the actual facts/argument that succeeded or failed, not just the denial_reasons codes. This is what a person skimming the report reads instead of decoding codes.
fields.lessons: 1-3 bullets: what a future NIW petition should do differently in light of this decision
